title: superdesigndev/treg: a routing layer for agent tools
friendlyTitle: Treg helps AI agents choose between different tools
summary: Treg describes itself as an OpenRouter-style layer for agent tools, maintaining a catalogue that agents can discover and route requests through rather than wiring every service separately. The fast-moving Python project has more than 2,000 stars and added about 197 stars in today’s GitHub Trending collection.
friendlySummary: Treg provides a shared catalogue and routing layer for services that AI agents can call. It was one of today’s fastest-rising AI projects on GitHub Trending.
whyItMatters: Agent builders can use it to compare and route specialised service calls behind a more consistent interface. Treat every connected vendor as a separate data boundary: inspect tool definitions, restrict credentials and test failure handling before allowing autonomous use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can reduce the work needed to connect an agent to many specialist services. Limit each service’s access and check where your data is sent.
